notes:
Lead: SMB inbound, building a hosted chatbot product for mid-market customers. Primary integration: support ticket ingestion + triage; tool-calling used to open tickets in their system. Signed up self-serve, using hosted API (public cloud). Short fragments from calls and investigation:
- Reported symptom: when using streaming + function-calls in JSON mode, client sometimes gets partial chunks that break JSON.parse -> 'Unexpected token <char>' and the function call payload is incomplete.
- Customer quote: "Works fine in small tests but in production bursts we see parser errors ~1-2% of requests".
- Observed server-side: model emits function_call with arguments spanning multiple stream events; some chunks appear to include control-chars or unescaped newlines introduced by their post-processing.
- Error messages: 'invalid function schema: missing required field "ticket_summary"' (schema validation on our side), and client-side: 'SyntaxError: Unexpected end of JSON input' when concatenating stream frames.
- Environment: Node.js backend for ingestion, SDK-js v1.3.2 (they said). Using fetch + TextDecoder streaming. Content-Type set to application/json for non-stream requests; streaming uses chunked transfer.
- Initial hypothesis: client concatenation logic and schema validation are brittle to whitespace/newlines in streamed arguments; also case-sensitivity in function name (their code expects 'createTicket' but schema registered as 'create_ticket').
- Repro steps done by Redwood SE: replayed streaming transcript, validated function schema in model config, toggled JSON mode variations (json, json-seq), forced a single-frame response (non-stream) which succeeded.
- Temporary mitigations suggested: 1) switch to non-streamed function call for critical ticket creation while we debug; 2) canonicalize function names and argument keys (snake_case vs camelCase) on both sides; 3) add defensive JSON buffer logic to tolerate control-chars; 4) upgrade to SDK-js >=1.4.0 which has fixed stream boundary handling.
- Customer constraints: cost sensitive (SMB), wants hosted API and no on-prem. Needs SOC2 + SSO for pilot. No dedicated SE time long-term — prefer short guided fixes.
- Quotes/paraphrases from SE session: "If we can lock down a reliable streaming pattern for function-calls we'll move forward with a paid tier".
- POC ask: sample request/response pair we can drop into their test harness; also a tiny helper lib snippet (20 lines) to normalize stream frames and validate schema before parsing.
- Notes for AE: emphasize hosted_api simplicity, mention upcoming SDK patch, offer 30m debug session + sample code.
- Internal follow-ups: open ticket RWD-2456 for SDK stream boundary fix; attach Fireflies ff-20260303-67a2d transcript to ticket.
